design: Three opaque behaviors, paired arms, one repeat. Shared case reverses arm order.
grading: Fixture-owned classification, cited request evidence, and cited identity/policy discovery records.
authorization: User explicitly approved up to 30 additional requests to complete the interrupted comparison.
restart_policy: Fresh run of the single budget-interrupted case; prior attempt retained. No completed case rerun.
scope: One exploratory repetition of the unknown-policy pair in reversed arm order. Primary outcomes remain fixed; no replacement of earlier results.
